verdict.rationale: Bolt.new documents native Supabase integration for provisioning a hosted SQL database (with auth and edge functions) either at project creation or later by connecting an existing Supabase project, all without leaving the builder [bolt-docs-8][bolt-docs-22][bolt-docs-27][bolt-docs-32]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the Supabase wiring works smoothly end-to-end (one community report notes SQLite persistence breaking under a different, non-Supabase setup [bolt-comm-4]), and some community critique that outsourcing to Supabase limits depth of backend control [bolt-comm-11].
